title: Operacije: kontrole, ranjivosti i monitoring
summary: Mitigacione kontrole (od segmentacije i honeypota do EDR-a, NAC-a i SPF/DKIM/DMARC), upravljanje imovinom, životni ciklus upravljanja ranjivostima i alati za alerting i monitoring (SIEM, NetFlow, SNMP, syslog, SCAP).
summary_en: Mitigating controls (from segmentation and honeypots to EDR, NAC, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC), asset management, the vulnerability management lifecycle, and alerting and monitoring tools (SIEM, NetFlow, SNMP, syslog, SCAP).
